chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

You will not see what you love (the appearance of Al-Qaim) until the Clan of So-and-so differ among themselves. So when they differ, the people will become greedy, the word will be divided, and Al-Sufyani will emerge.

key_terms.بَنُو فُلَانٍ: Clan of So-and-so (often referring to the Abbasids)
key_terms.تَفَرَّقَتِ الْكَلِمَةُ: The word/division was separated (fragmentation of unity)

ai.seo_question: What events must occur before the appearance of Al-Qaim according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (as) identifies the internal fragmentation of the Banu Umayya or Banu Abbas as a critical precursor to the global emergence of Al-Sufyani and the Mahdi (aj). This political disunity creates the necessary conditions of widespread greed and divided allegiance, fulfilling the eschatological timeline where the 'word' (al-kalimah) is scattered before being re-established by the Imam.

en.hubeali: H 14702 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws said:

‘You will not be seeing what you would love to (appearance of Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup>) until the Clan of so and so (Clan of Abbas) differing in what is between them. So when they differ, the people would become greedy and the words would be separated, and Al-Sufyani would come out’.
en.sarwar: 254. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, who has said: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said:

‘You will not be seeing what you would love to (appearance of Al-Qaim (a.s.)) until the Clan of so and so (Clan of Abbas) differing in what is between them. So when they differ, the people would become greedy and the words would be separated, and Al-Sufyani would come out’.
